name: reichman-courses
description: Ask Claude about your Reichman courses: Moodle, syllabi, grades, lecture recordings & transcripts, Piazza. Unofficial, read-only, runs on your computer.

username.title: Reichman username
username.description: The username you use for Moodle / My RUNI.

password.title: Reichman password
password.description: Used only to sign in to the university login page. It is stored securely by your computer and never sent anywhere except Reichman's own login.

piazza_email.title: Piazza email (optional)
piazza_email.description: Only if you use Piazza. It has a separate login from Reichman. Leave blank to skip Piazza.

piazza_password.title: Piazza password (optional)
piazza_password.description: Your Piazza password. Stored securely by your computer; used only to sign in to Piazza.

tools.name: get_syllabus
tools.description: A course syllabus: topics, grade formula, AI policy, attendance, reading list

tools.name: get_course_contents
tools.description: Sections, activities and files in a course

tools.name: read_course_file
tools.description: Read a PDF or text file from a course

tools.name: get_upcoming_deadlines
tools.description: Upcoming due dates across all courses

tools.name: get_assignments
tools.description: A course's assignments with due dates

tools.name: get_my_grades
tools.description: Your grades in a course's Moodle gradebook

tools.name: get_announcements
tools.description: Latest posts in a course's announcements forum

tools.name: search_course_materials
tools.description: Find activities and files by name across courses

tools.name: forget_my_data
tools.description: Delete the course data this connector saved on your computer

tools.name: get_official_grades
tools.description: Official grades from the Student Info Station
